96    //doesn't name a valid rank or an existing tag (another tab or device switched the collection,
97    //or the cookie expired), we fall back to showing by topics (the set of the current tsumego).
98    private function resolveQueryType(): void
99    {
100        $lastSet = Util::cookie('lastSet') ?? '';
101        if ($this->tsumegoFilters->query == 'difficulty')
102        {
103            if (empty($lastSet))
104            {
105                $this->tsumegoFilters->query = 'topics';
106                return;
107            }
108            try
109            {

111            }
112            catch (RatingParseException $e)
113            {
114                $this->tsumegoFilters->query = 'topics';
115            }
116        }
117        elseif ($this->tsumegoFilters->query == 'tags')
118        {
119            if (!empty($lastSet))
120                $this->tag = TableRegistry::getTableLocator()->get('Tag')->find()->where(['name' => $lastSet])->first();
121            if (!$this->tag)
122                $this->tsumegoFilters->query = 'topics';
123        }
124    }

127    {
